pages: Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, stands holding one green-covered logbook open, a pencil laid on the ruled sheet. Middle distance: two boiler shells and lagged pipework. Background: the basement plant room, low concrete ceiling, one caged lamp, grey night light.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, lays the flat of one hand on the bonnet of a brass safety valve high on the boiler shell. Middle distance: a round gauge and a lagged elbow. Background: the boiler room, bare bulb light, painted brick.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, kneels at the feed pump and presses one fingertip to the gland nut where water beads on the packing. Middle distance: the flue fan housing and a laundry trolley. Background: the plant room, grey night light.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, eyes shut, the flat of one hand held against a lagged relief pipe, waiting. Middle distance: a brass sample cock and the boiler shell. Background: the boiler room, one caged lamp, condensation on the lagging.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, stands holding one clipboard at chest height, one finger laid on a row of small ticks. Middle distance: the boiler shell and its safety valve. Background: the plant room stairwell, morning light through wired glass.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, holds one clipboard flat and runs one finger down a column of dated ticks. Middle distance: a ring binder with a broken spine and a wall clock. Background: the office filing corner, daylight from a high window.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, stands over one galvanised bucket set under a brass sample cock, one hand on a stopwatch. Middle distance: the blowdown receiver and a floor drain. Background: the boiler room, hard white lamp light, low steam.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, crouches on the hospital lawn and lays one hand flat on a narrow band of dead brown grass. Middle distance: a cast iron manhole cover and a white bloom on the wall. Background: the service door, overcast daylight.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, stands at an office desk with one hand flat on a closed green-covered logbook, a typed sheet under her other hand. Middle distance: a desk telephone and a stack of papers. Background: the engineering office, window light.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, unrolls one old drawing on a workbench and holds it flat, tracing a pipe route with one finger. Middle distance: a cardboard drawing tube and a pencil. Background: the plant room, warm lamp light, hard shadows.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, stands at the safety valve with one hand on the discharge pipe and her head tilted, listening. Middle distance: the flue fan housing and a riser pipe. Background: the boiler room at dawn, grey slot-window light.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, presses the palm of one hand down on a red mushroom emergency stop button and holds it, watching the burner fan. Middle distance: the safety valve and a gauge with its needle high. Background: the boiler room.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, sits on an upturned crate writing the time in one green-covered logbook. Middle distance: a boiler shell and a wall telephone with the cord hanging. Background: the plant room, flat morning light through wired glass.

Bilal Naidu, a broad maintenance fitter in navy overalls, a canvas apron and safety glasses, crouches beside a freshly cut pipe and tips one galvanised bucket under the open end as water runs in. Middle distance: an inspection mirror on a rod and a coil of wire. Background: the plant room wall, work light on a stand.

Nadia Kora, a woman engineer in a grey coverall and safety glasses, turns one valve wheel on a portable test rig set on a steel trolley and watches the valve clamped to it. Middle distance: a tall nitrogen cylinder and a certificate book. Background: the plant room, daylight through the doorway.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, holds one green-covered logbook flat open, one finger under a folded certificate sheet showing two columns of figures. Middle distance: a valve spring on a bench tray and the test rig. Background: the plant room, cool daylight.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, stands with one hand flat on the shell of the single working boiler while the second stands cold and still beside it. Middle distance: the header pipe and the feed pump. Background: the basement plant room.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, writes with a pencil into one box on a test sheet clipped to a board, filling two ruled columns. Middle distance: the safety valve and the boiler shell. Background: the plant room, warm lamp light, gauge glass.

Miri Ngata, twenty-six, dark hair tied back, dark green boiler overall with a zip pocket on the left thigh, steel toe boots, rests one palm flat on the shut green-covered logbook on a steel ledge, her pencil beside it. Middle distance: the safety valve and a gauge with a steady needle. Background: the plant room, one caged lamp, dark.
